content.title: Why the ‘Everyone’s a Winner’ Energy Trade Can’t Last Forever
content.summary: Almost every corner of the power sector has rallied this year.  In the earlier days of the AI rally, investors piled into the stocks of nuclear and natural-gas power plant owners such as  Constellation Energy  and  Vistra  Since then, the rally has spread to almost every corner of the electricity universe.  Take renewable-energy stocks, which started the year weak as the sector’s subsidies landed on the chopping block as part of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
